usage_rule: Traits feed PHRASING and EVIDENCE selection. Never render trait labels as a raw adjective list. Show each trait through a concrete behaviour or outcome. Respect all banned-word/phrase lists (no 'cross-functional', 'collaborative' filler, 'strong communicator', 'proactive', 'dynamic', 'passionate').

traits.label: Calm approach
evidence_phrasings: Keeps decisions steady under production pressure
Ran change boards through escalations without raising the temperature
Steady point of contact when OEM requests stacked up

traits.label: Analytical and foresighted; structured, systematic
evidence_phrasings: Works from structured criteria: trade-off analysis, FMEA, DOE before commitment
Builds the decision framework before the decision
Maps downstream impact of a change before approving it

traits.label: Clear communicator, action taker
evidence_phrasings: Translates technical constraints into scope managers can act on
Short written decisions with owners and dates
Moves from analysis to commitment without circling

traits.label: Professional pride
evidence_phrasings: Holds output to audit-ready standard whether or not anyone audits
Documentation complete before handover, every time
Owns the result, including when the fix is unglamorous

traits.label: Moral compass, empathy, people's person
evidence_phrasings: Gives credit where the work happened
Raises problems early and to the right person
Fair in supplier and team dealings; reputation carries between projects

traits.label: People oriented: accommodating, helpful, team-worker, relation builder, reads the room
evidence_phrasings: Builds working relationships across optics, firmware, quality, and suppliers
Adapts the message to the listener: engineer, manager, or customer
First to help unblock a colleague; long-standing contacts at ODMs and OEMs
Reads the room and adjusts pace in negotiations and reviews

work_style_line.en: Calm, structured decisions from measured data; clear written outcomes; works through relationships across engineering, suppliers, and management.
work_style_line.da: Rolige, strukturerede beslutninger på målte data; klare skriftlige konklusioner; arbejder gennem relationer på tværs af teknik, leverandører og ledelse.

who_i_am.rule: 1-2 sentences. Identity + scope, no specialist niche in unsolicited register.
unsolicited: IT professional with 15+ years of experience around commercial and regulated markets and products.
IT specialist with 15+ years taking hardware-software products through commercial and regulated markets.

body_mind.rule: 1 sentence on what gives energy / makes him happy. Word 'passionate' stays banned; use 'makes me happy' / 'gives me energy'.
sentences: Rugby keeps me grounded: operations manager and assistant coach at Copenhagen Wolves RFC, foreningsarbejde that builds the club beyond the matchday squad.
Building things makes me happy: AntCV, a GenAI product I design, build, and ship solo.

special_capabilities.rule: Carried by the Work style line. One personality-bearing sentence maximum.
special_capabilities.underlying_message: Technical expert WITH human-reading skills and understanding of people. The combination is rare.
sentences: Technical depth paired with reading people: hears what is not said in a review and brings everyone along.
Engineering judgment plus the ability to read a room: rare in one person, used daily across teams, suppliers, and management.

cover_letter_who_i_am_fragment: Colleagues come to me when a decision needs a calm read of the data and a clear next step. I build the relationships that make hard changes land: with the engineer who owns the fix, the supplier who ships it, and the manager who answers for it.

kernel_fact_corrections.volunteer_interests_line: Operations manager & assistant coach, Copenhagen Wolves RFC (foreningsarbejde)
kernel_fact_corrections.courses: AI course (Copilot) — IDA Ingeniørforening. Distinct from AI-Practitioner (Teknologisk Institut); both stay.

render_constraints.rule: One personality-bearing sentence in Profile maximum; the rest carried by Work style line and cover letter Who I Am. Behaviour over adjectives.
